title: Retain original XML source locations for schema compilation
api_or_output: Internal revision-qualified source locations for ordinary parsed XML nodes/attributes/namespaces and guarded schema scope lookups; no public API change

acceptance.description: Retain copied original callback locations and document origin in a document-owned bounded-by-DOM sidecar without lexical buffers. Expose original node/attribute/namespace coordinates only for unchanged complete strict XML input; preserve known origin without XML declaration and guarded schema lookups. No fabricated coordinates for programmatic, cloned/imported, HTML, recovered or mutated input.

Test distinct local declaration/constraint positions, character scalar coordinates/null byte offsets, chunked byte input with supplementary scalars/newlines/byte offsets, redirected origins, mutation before/during traversal, foreign handles and untracked cases. Preserve prior XML/DTD/model behavior and public API.

Record focused checks, exact helper joins and source ownership plus applicable added metadata construction/retention and zero-allocation warm lookup evidence at pinned runtime. Integrate before schema compiler consumers use it.

handoff.summary: Bounded shared repair confirmed by read-only review: DomSink discards ordinary callback locations; frozen XSD local particle/attribute-use provenance needs them.
